beats.caption: Cullionboy, in Irish Cuilleann Buí, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Cullionboy and its 22 families, from the 1850s to 1954.
In the 1850s the land was valued and its occupiers listed. In all, 20 plots are numbered for Cullionboy. The occupiers included Dunlevy, Gillespie and Doherty.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records four baptisms at Cullionboy between 1874 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 93, 72 and 79 people in Cullionboy, in 18, 16 and 15 households. Heads of household included Gillespie, Gildea and McCool.
A photograph from 1954: Bella, Rose & Mary Kate Kelly on the Kelly family farm in Cullionboy.
